title: Garbage collection schedule
description: Pickup days per barangay, shown on the Everyday Info page. A barangay with no days shows "Schedule not yet posted".

lastUpdated.description: When the schedule was last checked, as YYYY-MM-DD (or "" if never). Shown on the page.

source.description: Where the schedule comes from, e.g. "City Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO)". Shown on the page.

barangay.description: Barangay name, exactly as written in barangays.json.

time.description: Usual pickup time, e.g. "6:00 AM – 10:00 AM".

notes.description: Anything residents should know, e.g. "Biodegradable on Mondays, non-biodegradable on Thursdays".
